slots.label: What photosynthesis needs and makes
slots.labelAf: Wat fotosintese nodig het en maak

items.q: Which two raw materials does a plant use for photosynthesis?
items.qAf: Watter twee grondstowwe gebruik ’n plant vir fotosintese?
items.explain: Photosynthesis uses carbon dioxide and water, with light energy, to make glucose and oxygen.
items.explainAf: Fotosintese gebruik koolstofdioksied en water, met lig-energie, om glukose en suurstof te maak.

items.q: Which gas is released by a plant during photosynthesis?
items.qAf: Watter gas word deur ’n plant tydens fotosintese vrygestel?
items.explain: Oxygen is a by-product of photosynthesis, released into the air through the leaves.
items.explainAf: Suurstof is ’n byproduk van fotosintese en word deur die blare in die lug vrygestel.

items.q: A leaf is kept in a dark cupboard for two days. What happens to its ability to photosynthesise?
items.qAf: ’n Blaar word twee dae lank in ’n donker kas gehou. Wat gebeur met sy vermoë om te fotosintetiseer?
options: It stops, because light is needed
optionsAf: Dit hou op, omdat lig nodig is
items.explain: Light energy is needed to drive photosynthesis, so without light the leaf cannot make glucose.
items.explainAf: Lig-energie is nodig om fotosintese aan die gang te hou, so sonder lig kan die blaar nie glukose maak nie.

items.q: Which process uses oxygen and releases carbon dioxide?
items.qAf: Watter proses gebruik suurstof en stel koolstofdioksied vry?
items.explain: Cellular respiration breaks down glucose with oxygen, releasing energy, carbon dioxide and water.
items.explainAf: Sellulêre respirasie breek glukose af met suurstof, en stel energie, koolstofdioksied en water vry.

items.q: In bright sunlight, which process is faster in a leaf?
items.qAf: In helder sonlig, watter proses is vinniger in ’n blaar?
items.explain: In bright light photosynthesis is faster than respiration, so the leaf takes in more carbon dioxide than it gives out.
items.explainAf: In helder lig is fotosintese vinniger as respirasie, so die blaar neem meer koolstofdioksied op as wat dit afgee.

items.q: Which process releases energy stored in glucose for the plant to use?
items.qAf: Watter proses stel energie vry wat in glukose geberg is?
items.explain: Respiration releases the energy stored in glucose, which the plant needs for growth and other processes.
items.explainAf: Respirasie stel die energie vry wat in glukose geberg is, en die plant het dit nodig vir groei en ander prosesse.

items.q: The green pigment in chloroplasts that absorbs light energy.
items.qAf: Die groen pigment in chloroplaste wat ligenergie absorbeer.

items.q: The small openings in a leaf through which gases move in and out.
items.qAf: Die klein openinge in ’n blaar waardeur gasse in en uit beweeg.

items.q: The sugar made by plants during photosynthesis.
items.qAf: Die suiker wat plante tydens fotosintese maak.

items.q: The organelle in which cellular respiration releases energy.
items.qAf: Die organel waarin sellulêre respirasie energie vrystel.

items.text: During photosynthesis, plants take in carbon dioxide and [[]] and use light energy to make glucose and [[]].
items.textAf: Tydens fotosintese neem plante koolstofdioksied en [[]] op en gebruik ligenergie om glukose en [[]] te maak.

items.text: Plants store extra glucose as [[]], which turns blue-black when [[]] solution is added.
items.textAf: Plante berg ekstra glukose as [[]] op, wat blou-swart word wanneer [[]]-oplossing bygevoeg word.

items.q: Plants carry out photosynthesis during the day and respiration only at night.
items.qAf: Plante voer bedags fotosintese uit en net snags respirasie.
items.explain: False. Plants respire all the time, day and night. Photosynthesis only happens when there is light.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Plante respireer heeltyd, dag en nag. Fotosintese vind net plaas wanneer daar lig is.

items.q: The oxygen that animals breathe in comes mainly from photosynthesis.
items.qAf: Die suurstof wat diere inasem, kom hoofsaaklik van fotosintese.
items.explain: True. Photosynthesis releases oxygen into the air, which animals use for respiration.
items.explainAf: Waar. Fotosintese stel suurstof in die lug vry, wat diere vir respirasie gebruik.

items.qAf: Respirasie stel energie uit glukose vry.
items.explain: True. In respiration glucose reacts with oxygen and the energy stored in it is released for the cell to use.
items.explainAf: Waar. Tydens respirasie reageer glukose met suurstof en die energie wat daarin gestoor is, word vrygestel vir die sel om te gebruik.

items.q: A learner puts a pot plant in a dark cupboard for two days and then tests a leaf for starch. Predict the result and explain it.
items.qAf: ’n Leerder sit ’n potplant vir twee dae in ’n donker kas en toets dan ’n blaar vir stysel. Voorspel die resultaat en verduidelik dit.
points: The test is negative: the iodine stays brown / no blue-black colour.
Without light the plant cannot photosynthesise, so no new starch is made.
The starch that was stored has been used up (in respiration).
pointsAf: Die toets is negatief: die jodium bly bruin / geen blou-swart kleur nie.
Sonder lig kan die plant nie fotosintetiseer nie, dus word geen nuwe stysel gemaak nie.
Die stysel wat gestoor was, is opgebruik (in respirasie).

items.q: Match each word equation in column A with the correct process in column B.
items.qAf: Pas elke woordvergelyking in kolom A by die regte proses in kolom B.
pairs: Glucose + oxygen → carbon dioxide + water + energy
Glucose → lactic acid + a little energy
Glucose → alcohol + carbon dioxide + a little energy
